c74object.name: touch.panel
c74object.digest: Subpatch Background Chassis and Diffusion Glass Component
c74object.description: A soft-chassis backdrop and optical diffusion glass panel designed for Max jsui/v8ui patchers and subpatcher windows. Features a 16-stop cosine directional diffusion smear engine, real-time wireless synchronization with touch.master (Page 1: Panels), adjustable glass spread and border geometry, pass-through click transparency, and an optional window-drag mode to move borderless parent patchers.

inlet.description: Receives bang or theme update messages to force re-synchronization with touch.master, or direct configuration messages to alter optical and geometry properties.

method.name: bang
method.description: Re-reads theme values from the global touch_theme_bus or persistent dictionary store and redraws the canvas.

method.name: theme_sync
method.description: Forces an immediate reload of panel glass colors, spread, radius, and border thickness from touch.master.

method.name: theme_update
method.description: Direct alias for theme_sync to process live broadcast events from the theme bus.

method.name: update
method.description: General update message. Also accepts aliases refresh and refresh_theme.

attribute.name: drag_patch
attribute.description:
Toggles mouse interaction logic:
0 = Pass-Through (Default): Sets box.ignoreclick = 1, allowing clicks, drags, and patch cords to pass through completely to background or foreground objects without obstruction.
1 = Window Drag: Sets box.ignoreclick = 0, allowing the user to click anywhere on the panel to drag and reposition the parent patcher window on screen (ideal for borderless floating subpatchers).

attribute.name: glass_inner
attribute.description: RGBA color defining the base substrate fill of the panel backdrop. Broadcast from touch.master as panel_glass_inner.

attribute.name: glass_outer
attribute.description: RGBA color defining the 16-stop directional perimeter diffusion gradient. Broadcast from touch.master as panel_glass_outer.

attribute.name: glass_spread
attribute.description: Distance in pixels that the 16-stop cosine diffusion gradient bleeds inward from the four perimeter edges (clamped $\ge 1.0$). Broadcast from touch.master as panel_glass_spread.

attribute.name: border_radius
attribute.description: Radius in pixels of the rounded rectangle corners of the panel body and border outline. Broadcast from touch.master as panel_border_radius.

attribute.name: border_size
attribute.description: Stroke width in pixels of the outer perimeter border outline. Broadcast from touch.master as panel_border_size.

attribute.name: border_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the outer perimeter border outline. Broadcast from touch.master as panel_border_color.
